answer:
Done — I made a Page for **Stocks I watch** that calculates invested amount, current value, and profit/loss per holding and in total.

Note: Amber Pages can’t make live web requests, so it can’t pull Yahoo Finance prices directly. I added a **Current price** column and made the page editable so you can enter/paste latest prices and have profit update automatically.

Deleting or replacing a page never loses data.
